metadata.description: Staz's Claude Code skills and agents.

plugins.name: orc
plugins.description: Orchestrator: keep working in your main session, and hand a piece to a cheaper or stronger tier agent only when it actually pays off.

plugins.name: orc-ledger
plugins.description: A status row for orc: one row above the prompt with this session's handoffs per tier and how many tier agents are still running. Optional; watches only; needs Claude Code 2.1.329 or later.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Save notes to, and recall them from, your Obsidian vaults: one vault per job plus a personal one, each with its own house rules.

plugins.name: dream
plugins.description: Consolidate and organize your memory notes, Claude auto-memory or an Obsidian vault, the way sleep consolidates a day: merge duplicates, retire superseded entries, add indexes, from a plan you approve first, with a backup before anything changes.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Review someone else's PR with an agent at your side, including code in a language you don't read well: plain-language explanation, independently verified findings, a draft you approve before anything is posted.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Turn a dense doc, page, issue or topic into a short animated step-through HTML explainer, built only from the source, with honest Confirmed / Likely / Not known chips. Writes one file; never publishes.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: A Yesterday / Today / Blockers standup report from your real GitHub activity. Plain text to read out or paste; never posts.

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: A career coach with memory: reads your career notes and past sessions from your brain vault, checks last session's commitments, coaches question-first with a straight opinion when asked, and saves each session back to the vault.

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: A compact boxed status board in the terminal for multi-step work: what is done, running, blocked, and the one thing that needs you. Replaces long prose progress reports.
